evidence.reason: provider_cooldowns() now validates the complete persisted document and raises CooldownStateError on any invalid timestamp (such as the empty zai stamp) before any comparison with utc(), while dispatch_paused() fail-closes on that corruption with an operator-recovery pause lifted only by repairing the file, so dispatch() can no longer spend against a known exhausted provider (tests not run: the harness permits only git commands; CI is the authority).
